checked_controls: Canonical request row must equal complete original frozen plan including canonical URL, size and SHA.
Only a canonical302 may cause one additional GET; storage redirect,403 or any non200 fails without retry.
Storage scheme HTTPS, exact nemar.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com netloc/host, no explicit port or userinfo; any literal fragment delimiter is rejected.
Storage object path is exactly derived from frozen dataset/size/SHA256E key; no prefix-only acceptance or arbitrary storage path.
Default original verified TLS/proxy/CA remains; a fresh opener/request per hop carries only Accept-Encoding identity, with no cookie/auth forwarding.
Caller control_check executes immediately before each canonical/storage GET, including after receiving302.
Final actual response.geturl is compared against the actual transient URL in memory; geturl is neither replaced nor forged.
Signed query/actual path is not in route metadata or controlled error arguments; public error normalization strips original network exception context/inner traceback frames.
Original exact Content-Length/identity encoding/bounded body reads/complete size and SHA/partial preservation/exclusive hardlink publication/fsync remain.
Original byte-only verify_cached_manifest and frozen manifest/provenance/license identities are reused.
